description: Review R3, R4, R5, R15, R21, D1-D3, D12 (plan 261027): `gate` adds to every text item's block an `Acts on:` line generated from kind, file, heading, variant and project, each JSON-quoted (the probe: a stale item whose text names `Decoy` and whose fields name `Real target` shows the real target), and to a drafted promotes item `Also removes memory entry: <file> § <heading>` above its options. Every line an agent wrote (a text item, the preamble, and each continuation line of a value) starts with `> `, so a forged `Acts on:` or `Also removes memory entry:` line, in any case and behind any invisible character, shows marked; a quote or separator in a value stays inside its quotes; runs of spaces show as written and reach decisions.json. A control character, a lone carriage return, a Unicode line separator or a bidirectional control in any string or key of gate-items.json, at any depth, is refused. `decisions` copies the promotes overlay only on Apply; a field changed after the gate is refused. A drafted item's variant must be promotes with a file and heading; a text item's file must be absolute. An id holding a newline collapses to one row of `gate --index`. Review R15: an answers.json `track` is a list of absolute paths. Review E1: a promotes heading holding a quote and a backslash is shown JSON-quoted, reaches decisions.json as written, and passes `handoff check decisions.json`.
